canon.note: Fire Nihility, energyMax 130. Basic 132101 Fiddle... Fissured Memory: single-hit Fire DMG; engine L6 mult 1.0. Skill 132102 Lick... Enkindled Betrayal (Blast): deploys a Zone lasting skill_a2 (=3) turns that gives all allies WBE +skill_a3 (=0.5) and enables Super Break from non-broken Toughness Reduction; deals Fire DMG = #1% to target + adjacent (skill_a3 also feeds WBE here; engine applies the same #1 coeff to both, primary Toughness 60 / adjacent 30); engine L6 mult 1.6. Ultimate 132103 Wallow... Entombed Ash (AoE): inflicts Wilt (DEF -ult_a3, turns ult_a2) on all enemies then deals Fire DMG = #1% distributed evenly; engine L6 mult 3.0, ult_a3 defRed, ult_a2 turns; also implant Weakness of all Dance Partners' Types via A2 (applyToughness +20). Talent 132104 Who's Afraid of Constance?: on combat entry +talent_a4 Energy and Dance Partner = highest-Break-Effect teammate; when the OTHER Dance Partner attacks, Dahlia launches a Follow-Up ATK of talent_a2 instances (each Fire DMG = #1% to a random enemy) and converts each instance's Toughness Reduction on a Broken target into talent_a3% Super Break; the partner's attack on a Broken target converts its Toughness Reduction into talent_a5% Super Break; A1 recovers 1 SP per 2 FUA uses. A0 Yet Another Funeral: allies' Break Effect = 24% of Dahlia's + 50%, 1 turn. E1: talent conversion applies to ALL allies (+40% on partner) and partner attacks drain 25% Max Toughness once per enemy. E2: all enemies All-RES -20% (resAll) + Wilt on entry. E4: Talent FUA +5 instances and enemies DMG taken +12% 2t. E6: Dance Partner Break Effect +150% and 20% Action Advance on Talent FUA.

fixtures.env: The Dahlia E0 + Feixiao E0 vs 1 Fire-weak Boss (Lv120, 400k HP, 400 Toughness), auto rotation, 12 cycles, seed 81 — exercises Skill Zone, Ult Wilt, Basic, and the Dance Partner Talent FUA + Super Break
The Dahlia E6 + Feixiao E0 vs the same Fire-weak Boss, 12 cycles, seed 84 — exercises the cumulative level bumps (E3 Talent +2 / E5 Skill +2) plus the E2/E4/E6 runtime buffs

requirements.claim: The Skill (Lick... Enkindled Betrayal) is cast in the fixture.
The Ultimate (Wallow... Entombed Ash) is cast in the fixture.
The Basic (Fiddle... Fissured Memory) is cast when SP runs out.
Skill primary deals 1.6x at engine L6 (canon 132102 #1).
Ultimate deals 3.0x at engine L6 (canon 132103 #1).
Talent FUA instances deal 0.3x at engine L6 (canon 132104 #1).
Basic deals 1.0x at engine L6 (canon 132101 #1).
Ultimate inflicts Wilt (DEF reduction) on the enemy (canon 132103).
Skill deploys the Zone buff on allies (WBE; canon 132102).
A0 Yet Another Funeral gives allies Break Effect at battle start (bonus_abilities).
Talent Follow-Up ATK fires repeatedly when the Dance Partner attacks (25 instances in the fixture).
Toughness Reduction from the Dance Partner's attacks / Talent FUA on a Broken target is converted to Super Break.
The Fire-weak Boss is broken during the fixture (enables the Super Break conversion).
The Skill Zone that enables Super Break is deployed before the first Super Break resolves.
The Dahlia regenerates exactly 173 Energy across the E0 fixture (Basic +20, Skill +30, Talent +35 on entry, A2 ult +13).
E6 gives the Dance Partner +150% Break Effect (dahl_e6).
E2 reduces all enemies' All-Type RES by 20% (dahl_a2 resAll -0.2).
E4 Talent FUA applies DMG-taken +12% (dahl_r4) on enemies.
E6 Talent FUA grants the 20% Action Advance (self real, partner mid-turn lost).
At E6 the Skill mult rises to 1.76x: the cumulative E5 'Skill Lv.+2' is applied.
